result.topic_en: Gauss transforms the elliptic integral ∫dφ/√(1−sin²M sin²φ) by a substitution, relates it to arithmetic-geometric means M(1+x,1−x), and determines the coefficients of a power series from a differential equation by comparing coefficients in tables; the edge of the facing page has related series in f.

methods.what: Substitution transforming the elliptic integral with modulus sin M into one in the new variable φ'
Combination of reciprocals of arithmetic-geometric means as a general solution form
Method of undetermined coefficients: power series ansatz with its derivatives, substituted into a differential equation and coefficients compared in a table
Series for the second derivative of the ansatz
Power series for P in f
